children.value: > Fact From Story: On Sept. 13, Flexport founder Ryan Petersen took the stage at North America's premier supply chain conference in Phoenix. It was exactly a week after he'd forced out his hand-picked successor as CEO, ex-Amazon executive Dave Clark, so Petersen could once again run the show.
> > Fact From Story: Sitting in the first few rows of attendees was Clark, the man he'd ousted just a year into the job.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: It is unusual for someone who has been forced out of a job to attend a conference where their successor is speaking.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A founder forcing out a hand-picked successor as CEO indicates a tumultuous situation.
